item.summary: fix(ui): keep the archive Undo working after leaving the Sessions page (#123749) The archive toast outlives the Sessions page (toast host is app-shell level), but its Undo action was gated on the page's request scope, which dies the moment the operator navigates away — clicking Undo within the 6s window then silently did nothing. Run the un-archive through the shared sessions mutations store directly (it already fails closed on connection replacement and publishes errors), mirroring the always-mounted sidebar undo sibling.
